manifest_version.specNote: Specifies manifest specification version (2 or 3). MV2 is deprecated on Chrome Web Store.
manifest_version.migrationNote: Increment from 2 to 3. Initiates all MV3 breaking changes and security policies.

name.specNote: Extension display title in browser UI, Web Store, and extensions management page.
name.migrationNote: Unchanged between MV2 and MV3. Can use i18n __MSG_messagename__ format.

version.specNote: SemVer string (1-4 dot-separated integers) indicating release version.

description.specNote: Brief summary (max 132 chars) displayed in Web Store and extension listings.

author.specNote: Developer or publishing organization identity string.

icons.specNote: Map of sizes (16, 32, 48, 128) pointing to icon asset files.

action.specNote: Consolidated toolbar action button. Unifies MV2 browser_action and page_action.
action.migrationNote: Replace 'browser_action' or 'page_action' key with 'action'. Update chrome.browserAction API calls to chrome.action.

browser_action.specNote: Legacy toolbar button present on all pages.
browser_action.migrationNote: Deprecated in MV3. Must migrate to 'action' and chrome.action.* APIs.

page_action.specNote: Legacy contextual toolbar/address bar button enabled conditionally per tab.
page_action.migrationNote: Deprecated in MV3. Merge into 'action' and use chrome.action.enable/disable(tabId).

background.specNote: MV3: service_worker (event-driven, ephemeral). MV2: persistent background scripts/page.
background.migrationNote: Change 'scripts: [...]' or 'page: ...' to 'service_worker: ...'. Remove DOM/window references. Use chrome.alarms and chrome.storage instead of global in-memory state.

permissions.specNote: Declared browser APIs. In MV3, host domain match patterns are forbidden here.
permissions.migrationNote: Move all host patterns (e.g. *://*.example.com/*) out of 'permissions' into 'host_permissions'.

host_permissions.specNote: Dedicated separation of web domain match patterns that the extension can access.
host_permissions.migrationNote: Added in MV3. Extract all URLs and match patterns from MV2 'permissions' into this key.

optional_permissions.specNote: APIs requested at runtime via chrome.permissions.request() upon user action.
optional_permissions.migrationNote: Unchanged. Recommended in MV3 to minimize store review delays.

content_scripts.specNote: Scripts and stylesheets injected directly into web pages matching defined URL patterns.
content_scripts.migrationNote: In MV3, match patterns are strictly validated. For programmatic injection, use chrome.scripting.executeScript().

web_accessible_resources.specNote: Assets accessible to web page contexts. MV3 enforces scoped match patterns.
web_accessible_resources.migrationNote: In MV3, must be an array of objects specifying both 'resources: [...]' and 'matches: [...]' instead of a flat string array.

options_ui.migrationNote: Preferred over legacy options_page in both MV2 and MV3.

side_panel.specNote: Modern native browser side panel UI surface (Chrome 114+).
side_panel.migrationNote: Added in MV3. Declare 'side_panel: { default_path: ... }' and request 'sidePanel' permission.

commands.specNote: Global or browser-scoped keyboard shortcuts via chrome.commands API.

declarativeNetRequest.specNote: Privacy-preserving declarative network request modification and ad/tracker blocking engine.
declarativeNetRequest.migrationNote: Added in MV3 to replace blocking chrome.webRequest. Define rule_resources and rule JSON files.

declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess.specNote: Declarative network rules applied only to domains for which the extension has host permissions.
declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess.migrationNote: Allows conditional DNR blocking without requesting full host permissions globally upfront.

content_security_policy.specNote: Sandbox and script execution security policy. MV3 strictly forbids remote hosted code.
content_security_policy.migrationNote: In MV3, must be an object with 'extension_pages' and optional 'sandbox' keys. 'unsafe-eval' and remote CDN scripts are banned.

devtools_page.specNote: Inspect panel extension page embedded into Chrome Developer Tools.
devtools_page.migrationNote: Unchanged. Communicates with background worker via chrome.runtime.connect().

omnibox.specNote: Keyword triggering interactive search or suggestions in the browser address bar.

default_locale.specNote: Default locale folder under _locales/ for internationalized extensions.

short_name.specNote: Short title displayed when space is constrained (e.g. app launchers).

offline_enabled.specNote: Boolean indicating whether the extension operates without an active internet connection.

minimum_chrome_version.specNote: Minimum browser version required to run this extension.
minimum_chrome_version.migrationNote: Set to at least '88' for MV3, or '114' for side_panel support.

key.specNote: Public key fingerprint preserving persistent extension ID during local development.
key.migrationNote: Unchanged. Useful in development to avoid ID churn.

update_url.specNote: Custom autoupdate XML manifest URL for self-hosted enterprise extensions.
update_url.migrationNote: Forbidden for extensions published directly to the Chrome Web Store.

sandbox.specNote: Isolated HTML pages running in a unique origin sandbox (allowed eval/inline scripts).
sandbox.migrationNote: In MV3, communication must go through window.postMessage with extension pages.

chrome_url_overrides.migrationNote: Only one override allowed per extension.

storage.specNote: Declaration of managed storage schema for enterprise enterprise policies.

externally_connectable.specNote: Specifies which web pages and other extensions can connect via chrome.runtime.connect().

user_scripts.specNote: API allowing user scripts managers (like Violentmonkey/Tampermonkey) to execute in MV3.
user_scripts.migrationNote: Added in Chrome 120+. Requires 'userScripts' permission and developer mode.
